The 1 `log` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## log.read

Log messages (engine, editor and scripts), oldest first after a sequence number, or with newest: true the latest first. Page oldest first with after = the returned latest, newest first with before = the returned oldest, while more is true. Reading from level Error or below without a logger marks the errors read for editor.status (errors.unread).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Session` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `editor` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorStateCommands.cpp:999`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `after` | integer | no |   | Only messages with a sequence number above this (default 0). Value: at least `0`, at most `9223372036854775807`. |
| `before` | integer | no |   | Only messages with a sequence number below this (default: none). Value: at least `1`, at most `9223372036854775807`. |
| `limit` | integer | no |   | Maximum number of messages (default 200). Value: at least `1`, at most `10000`. |
| `logger` | string | no |   | Only messages of this logger (exact name, e.g. Strata, App, Script). |
| `maxCount` | integer | no |   | The former name of limit. Value: at least `1`, at most `10000`. |
| `minLevel` | string | no |   | Lowest level returned (default Info). One of: `Trace`, `Info`, `Warn`, `Error`, `Critical`. |
| `newest` | boolean | no |   | Newest first: the latest messages (default false: oldest first). |
